open_gaps.gap: R5c regresses at honestly matched total NFE (+9.2% to +14.6% FID). Root cause: apply_restart_distribution builds blend = m*x1_hat + (1-m)*x0, which is exactly the linear-FM path state at t = m, but solve_ode hard-coded the interval [0,1]. So every restart re-traversed the full path from a state that is not a valid t=0 state. Invariant violated: beta=0 ('keep everything') is NOT a no-op (measured max|delta| = 1.0137, 24.9% relative drift on a [-1,1] signal).
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) solve_ode honours t0/t1 from ODEConditionDelta with defaults 0/1 so legacy calls stay byte-identical. (2) --restart-t0-mode {zero,memory} and --nfe-allocation {scheduler,uniform,proportional}. (3) beta=0 under memory mode is an exact no-op (unit test). (4) D.4 30/30. (5) N=200 mechanism screen done (5 mechanisms, 25 configs, 3 genuine draws) and recorded in the audit; N=1000 confirmation is now folded into GAP-57, where the regime ladder is re-measured at equal total NFE so a confirmation is not spent on a cell the mechanism cannot win.
open_gaps.result: Root cause confirmed and fixed: solve_ode ignored t0/t1, so a restart whose blend is the path state at t=m was re-integrated over the full [0,1] with a 1/(1-m) times too large step. beta=0 was not a no-op (max|delta|=1.0137, 24.9% relative drift). Second defect: the prior is keyed only on (batch_id, sample_id) and solve_ode discards its seed, so the Wave 280 '3-seed' R5c runs are three byte-identical copies. After the fix (t0=memory + equal total NFE + proportional allocation) the regression roughly halves but does not vanish: legacy +10.8..+20.9% -> +6.7..+9.7% at NFE=50 (three genuine prior draws, 18/18 cells positive, sign test p~3.8e-06). 25 configurations across five sampler-side mechanisms (beta budget, restart start time, NFE allocation, round count, total budget) never beat the baseline anywhere in NFE in [3,50]. FID decomposition: the sampler moves ~1 unit of an ~11-unit model-versus-reference gap, and the baseline reaches its FID floor by ~15 NFE. The historical -28.43% was measured on the smoke checkpoint. Conclusion: the sampler-side lever is exhausted on the production checkpoint; the governing variable is the model's own residual error (GAP-35), which now has to be re-tested under equal total NFE (GAP-57).

open_gaps.gap: GAP-35 established that the restart gain is monotone in the model's optimisation budget (78-93 steps -> -25..-28%; 937+ steps -> +3..+10%), i.e. the mechanism corrects residual velocity-field error. But every framework arm in that table was run at the legacy per-round cap (~2x the baseline's NFE; GAP-44: R5c arms 25/48/25 vs baseline 50), so the magnitude of every win is confounded with compute. GAP-55 and GAP-56 showed that once total NFE is matched the production checkpoint regresses. Whether the GAP-35 ladder survives equal total NFE is unknown, and it decides whether R5c is a validated mechanism with a documented boundary or a compute artefact.
open_gaps.acceptance: (1) Re-run the GAP-35 ladder checkpoints (w16e1_5k, w16e1_10k, w16e1_60k) with equal total NFE=50, --restart-t0-mode memory, --nfe-allocation proportional, GAP-56 beta, N=200, 3 genuine prior draws (--seed-keyed-prior 42/43/44). (2) For each checkpoint report baseline FID, best-arm FID, paired delta with CI, and the regression line of delta% on baseline FID. (3) The ladder survives only if the delta% at w16e1_5k stays negative and significant under equal NFE; otherwise record R5c as a compute-confounded historical result and close the cell. (4) No new seeds beyond 42/43/44; seeds are a diagnostic axis, never a significance lever.
open_gaps.agent_action: 1) Done: 12 runs + bootstrap + aggregation. 2) Remaining before any status label moves: N=1000 confirmation on w16e1_5k only (the one checkpoint where the mechanism wins), same 3 draws. 3) Do not re-tune R/beta at w16e1_5k after seeing the result - that would be seed-style engineering on a hyper-parameter axis; record it as an open gap instead. 4) Paper surfaces stay untouched until the user authorises the restatement of R5c.
open_gaps.evidence: docs/audit/gap57-equal-nfe-regime-ladder.md; reproduce/gap57_equal_nfe_ladder.sh; tools/gap57_regime_ladder.py; verification_outputs/gap57-equal-nfe-ladder/ (12 run dirs, each with sweep_summary.json + paired_bootstrap.json)
open_gaps.result: The ladder survives equal total NFE (50 on both sides), with roughly half the historical magnitude. N=200, 3 genuine prior draws (42/43/44), 4 checkpoints, record-level paired bootstrap B=2000. w16e1_5k (baseline 27.198+-0.707): cosine -13.18%, 9/9 cells favour the framework with CI excluding 0. w16e1_10k (19.207+-0.600): cosine -1.89%, 4/9 cells win. w16e1_60k (13.512+-0.740): +10.48%, 0/9. production (12.488+-0.483): +6.08%, 0/9. Census 13 wins / 18 losses / 5 ties over 36 cells. Delta% regressed on baseline FID: slope -1.145 %/FID, R2 0.925, zero crossing at FID 21.1. The compute confound was 9.33pp of the 22.52pp headline win at w16e1_5k (~41%); GAP-35's -25.39% is a chunk-mean estimator and its 3 'seeds' are one draw with three chunk partitions. Two cells the driver's chunk test calls significant regressions (w16e1_10k codimension s42/s44) are ties at record level. Conclusion: the mechanism is real and bounded - it wins when the baseline FID is above ~21 and regresses below ~19; the production cell stays a regression. The honest R5c-family effect size at matched NFE is -13.18%, not -28.43% (smoke ckpt) and not -25.39% (chunk-mean).
